"""Integration coverage for ABC and legacy plugin interfaces."""

import pytest

from pylint import interfaces
from pylint.checkers import BaseChecker
from pylint.constants import WarningScope
from pylint.lint import PyLinter
from pylint.reporters import BaseReporter


def plugin_class(base, interface, membership):
    """Create independent classes so ABC registrations cannot leak between tests."""
    bases = (base, interface) if membership == "inherited" else (base,)
    plugin = type("Plugin", bases, {})
    if membership in ("registered", "both"):
        interface.register(plugin)
    if membership in ("legacy", "both"):
        plugin.__implements__ = (interface,)
    return plugin


@pytest.mark.parametrize("membership", ["inherited", "registered", "legacy", "both"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "interface, callback",
    [
        (interfaces.IRawChecker, "process_module"),
        (interfaces.ITokenChecker, "process_tokens"),
        (interfaces.IAstroidChecker, "visit_module"),
    ],
)
def test_interface_checker_dispatch(tmp_path, interface, callback, membership):
    calls = []

    class Checker(BaseChecker):
        name = "interface-plugin"
        msgs = {"W9901": ("Plugin called", "plugin-called", "Test plugin callback.")}

    def process(self, value):
        calls.append(value)
        if interface is interfaces.IAstroidChecker:
            self.add_message("plugin-called", node=value)
        else:
            self.add_message("plugin-called", line=1)

    setattr(Checker, callback, process)
    reporter = BaseReporter()
    linter = PyLinter(reporter=reporter)
    checker = plugin_class(Checker, interface, membership)(linter)
    linter.register_checker(checker)
    source = tmp_path / "sample.py"
    source.write_text("value = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")

    linter.check([str(source)])

    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert [message.symbol for message in reporter.messages] == ["plugin-called"]
    expected_scope = (
        WarningScope.NODE
        if interface is interfaces.IAstroidChecker
        else WarningScope.LINE
    )
    assert checker.messages[0].scope == expected_scope


@pytest.mark.parametrize("membership", ["inherited", "registered", "legacy", "both"])
def test_interface_reporter_registration(membership):
    reporter_class = plugin_class(BaseReporter, interfaces.IReporter, membership)
    reporter_class.name = "interface-reporter"
    linter = PyLinter()
    linter.register_reporter(reporter_class)
    linter.set_option("output-format", reporter_class.name)

    assert type(linter.reporter) is reporter_class
    assert linter.reporter.linter is linter
    linter.open()
    linter.set_current_module("sample")
    linter.add_message("fatal", args="Test reporter", line=1)
    assert [message.symbol for message in linter.reporter.messages] == ["fatal"]

class Interface:
    """Base class for interfaces."""

    @classmethod
    def is_implemented_by(cls, instance):
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)
            return implements(instance, cls)


def implements(
    obj: BaseChecker,
    interface: type[Interface] | tuple[type[Interface], ...],
) -> bool:
    """Does the given object (maybe an instance or class) implement the interface."""
    # TODO: 3.0: Remove deprecated function # pylint: disable=fixme
    warnings.warn(
        "implements has been deprecated in favour of using basic "
        "inheritance patterns without using __implements__.",
        DeprecationWarning,
    )
    implements_ = getattr(obj, "__implements__", ())
    if not isinstance(implements_, (list, tuple)):
        implements_ = (implements_,)
    return any(issubclass(i, interface) for i in implements_)

    """Base interface, to be used only for sub interfaces definition."""

    def open(self):
        """Called before visiting project (i.e. set of modules)."""

    def close(self):
        """Called after visiting project (i.e. set of modules)."""

    """Interface for checker which need to parse the raw file."""

    def process_module(self, node: nodes.Module) -> None:
        """Process a module.

        The module's content is accessible via ``astroid.stream``
        """


class ITokenChecker(IChecker):
    """Interface for checkers that need access to the token list."""

    def process_tokens(self, tokens: list[TokenInfo]) -> None:
        """Process a module.

        Tokens is a list of all source code tokens in the file.
        """


class IAstroidChecker(IChecker):
    """Interface for checker which prefers receive events according to
    statement type
    """


class IReporter(Interface):
    """Reporter collect messages and display results encapsulated in a layout."""

        """Handle the given message object."""

        """Display results encapsulated in the layout tree."""

"""Tests for interface membership and legacy interface declarations."""

from abc import ABCMeta

import pytest

from pylint import interfaces


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "interface",
    [
        interfaces.IChecker,
        interfaces.IRawChecker,
        interfaces.ITokenChecker,
        interfaces.IAstroidChecker,
        interfaces.IReporter,
    ],
)
def test_interface_membership(interface):
    """Interfaces support inheritance and virtual subclass registration."""
    assert isinstance(interface, ABCMeta)

    class Inherited(interface):
        pass

    class Descendant(Inherited):
        pass

    class Registered:
        pass

    class RegisteredDescendant(Registered):
        pass

    interface.register(Registered)

    for cls in (Inherited, Descendant, Registered, RegisteredDescendant):
        assert isinstance(cls(), interface)
        assert issubclass(cls, interface)
        assert isinstance(cls(), interfaces.Interface)

    assert not isinstance(object(), interface)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "declaration",
    [
        interfaces.IRawChecker,
        (interfaces.IRawChecker,),
        [interfaces.IRawChecker],
    ],
)
def test_legacy_interface_declarations(declaration):
    """Legacy declarations still recognize the interface and its bases."""

    class LegacyChecker:
        __implements__ = declaration

    for obj in (LegacyChecker, LegacyChecker()):
        for interface in (interfaces.IRawChecker, interfaces.IChecker):
            with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning, match="implements has been deprecated"):
                assert interfaces.implements(obj, interface)
            assert interface.is_implemented_by(obj)
        with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning, match="implements has been deprecated"):
            assert not interfaces.implements(obj, interfaces.ITokenChecker)

def test_crash_in_file(

    with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):

"""Integration coverage for ABC and legacy plugin interfaces."""

import pytest

from pylint import interfaces
from pylint.checkers import BaseChecker
from pylint.constants import WarningScope
from pylint.lint import PyLinter
from pylint.reporters import BaseReporter


def plugin_class(base, interface, membership):
    """Create independent classes so ABC registrations cannot leak between tests."""
    bases = (base, interface) if membership == "inherited" else (base,)
    plugin = type("Plugin", bases, {})
    if membership in ("registered", "both"):
        interface.register(plugin)
    if membership in ("legacy", "both"):
        plugin.__implements__ = (interface,)
    return plugin


@pytest.mark.parametrize("membership", ["inherited", "registered", "legacy", "both"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "interface, callback",
    [
        (interfaces.IRawChecker, "process_module"),
        (interfaces.ITokenChecker, "process_tokens"),
        (interfaces.IAstroidChecker, "visit_module"),
    ],
)
def test_interface_checker_dispatch(tmp_path, interface, callback, membership):
    calls = []

    class Checker(BaseChecker):
        name = "interface-plugin"
        msgs = {"W9901": ("Plugin called", "plugin-called", "Test plugin callback.")}

    def process(self, value):
        calls.append(value)
        if interface is interfaces.IAstroidChecker:
            self.add_message("plugin-called", node=value)
        else:
            self.add_message("plugin-called", line=1)

    setattr(Checker, callback, process)
    reporter = BaseReporter()
    linter = PyLinter(reporter=reporter)
    checker = plugin_class(Checker, interface, membership)(linter)
    linter.register_checker(checker)
    source = tmp_path / "sample.py"
    source.write_text("value = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")

    linter.check([str(source)])

    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert [message.symbol for message in reporter.messages] == ["plugin-called"]
    expected_scope = (
        WarningScope.NODE
        if interface is interfaces.IAstroidChecker
        else WarningScope.LINE
    )
    assert checker.messages[0].scope == expected_scope


@pytest.mark.parametrize("membership", ["inherited", "registered", "legacy", "both"])
def test_interface_reporter_registration(membership):
    reporter_class = plugin_class(BaseReporter, interfaces.IReporter, membership)
    reporter_class.name = "interface-reporter"
    linter = PyLinter()
    linter.register_reporter(reporter_class)
    linter.set_option("output-format", reporter_class.name)

    assert type(linter.reporter) is reporter_class
    assert linter.reporter.linter is linter
    linter.open()
    linter.set_current_module("sample")
    linter.add_message("fatal", args="Test reporter", line=1)
    assert [message.symbol for message in linter.reporter.messages] == ["fatal"]
